data.verdict: SUB-PIECE (ii) IS ESSENTIAL, NOT COSMETIC — the binding constraint QUANTIFIED: the Markov Gram (Hecke-invariant, q₀) and the Hodge Gram (S₅-invariant, q→1) are BOTH diagonal in the shared seminormal basis (Schur-unique, off-diag < 1e-20) but their diagonal ratio rᵢ = ['1.0', '0.996501', '0.992962', '0.989398'] is NOT constant (spread 0.0106), so the Markov Gram is NOT proportional to the Hodge Gram under the naive q→1 identity — a SINGLE scalar c does not exist for τ=(q→1). The spread vanishes as q→1 with leading power ≈ 1.93 (certified q-deformation origin), so the open τ-functor must compensate exactly the q-deformation of the contravariant form — THAT is the content of (ii), now localised. This SHARPENS the assessment: the |c| obstacle is not the period-matrix det/tr ~20% normalization choice (#4206, a symptom) — it is that without the specific τ there is no c at all. The forms' tableau-wise ratio spans a 1.1% band; |c| stays τ-gated. A well-defined |c| therefore REQUIRES closing the τ=P categorical identification (or route C: an intrinsic τ-invariant ratio). Nothing wired; 1/(8π) phase-4; scope-(a).
